scan_scope: all 192 local and origin Bayesian-PhysTwin branch tips fetched before selection; every unique tracked text blob at those tips
selection_rule: For each public object with at least one take absent from the all-ref text audit, select the take minimizing SHA256(b'pokeflex-public-paired-v1\0' + take_id.encode('utf-8')); sort selected takes by object name; do not replace a selected take.
claim_boundary: Freshness is relative to the complete tracked Bayesian-PhysTwin git history at lock time. It does not imply that these public PokeFlex recordings were never examined by unrelated external work.
